approvedAdaptation.effect: Native TextProps replace the inherited HTML public surface. DOM-only members are the original owner-approved exclusions, not new exclusions invented for this reconciliation. Same-name native events retain native payloads. onClick maps to native onPress; class plumbing maps to native styles. Native core platform applicability is retained.

scope: Every canonical Text/PlaceholderText public prop, including all inherited HTML/ARIA/event members; native extras retain the approved core TextProps contract. Ref, runtime defaults, CSS, wrapper precedence and all assertions are mapped separately in roadmap3.5.1.1. No installed trait/event/pixel equivalence is inferred.
optionalAndDefaults: All enumerated canonical props are optional. Unauthored inherited props remain undefined at the wrapper. Explicit owned defaults and the native host/default/semantic/metrics/ref/event equivalents are mapped in roadmap3.5.1.1; native extras keep their approved core TextProps behavior.
